proposition: The later papers give Iskandar's reign as 1409-14 (812-17 AH) and, in Timurid-Mughal, say he was defeated and executed five years into it. The dissertation timeline splits Ibn Turka's time at Iskandar's court into 812-15/1409-12 (with a query-marked qadi appointment) and 815-17/1412-14, puts Iskandar's capture and blinding at 817/1414, but chapter 3 gives his death as 818/1415. The older project docs give his fall as 1415. Whether execution followed capture within a year is not settled by these pages.
